title: Scalar twisted-unit component from the explicit trace witness
statement: For the scalar P1 setup, an explicit witness of the second-trace exchange equality implies the twisted-unit exchange component equation. The witness is a strictly smaller intermediate proposition than the component equation.

source.place: Second identity, scalar trace base change before tensoring with q*K.

proof.text: Expand the twisted unit and trace exchange, apply the ambient twisted-unit mate to the square, and use the shifted line-square calculation. The remaining second-trace exchange is supplied by the explicit witness hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: Intermediate assembly from the explicit second-trace witness.

lean.statement: theorem scalar_component_from_trace (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)) (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] (htrace : ScalarTraceWitness l c k p hpl Y) : let Λ := (coefficient l c).X let L := line l c let T := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ X) 0).obj (L X)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧ let uq := scalarTwistedUnit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (T Y) (T (ProjectiveLine Y)) (scalarQLineIso l c k p hpl Y) let u₂ := scalarTwistedUnit Λ (secondProjection Y) (T (ProjectiveLine Y)) (T (diagonalSurface Y)) (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y) let F := moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) F.map uq ≫ secondTraceExchange l c k p hpl Y = (scalarQLineIso l c k p hpl Y).hom ≫ u₂
